content: Before taking nizatidine, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to other H2 blockers (such as cimetidine, famotidine, or ranitidine), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other complications. Certain symptoms may actually indicate a more serious underlying condition. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if clearly necessary. Nizatidine passes into breast milk, so consult your doctor before breastfeeding. Drug interactions can alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs as well as herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Some products require stomach acid for proper absorption, and since nizatidine reduces stomach acid, it may affect how well these products work. Additionally, this medication may interfere with certain laboratory tests, such as urine protein tests, potentially leading to false results. If someone overdoses and exhibits serious symptoms like passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Lifestyle changes, such as participating in stress reduction programs, quitting smoking, limiting alcohol intake, and making dietary adjustments (e.g., avoiding caffeine and certain spices), may enhance the effectiveness of this medication. Laboratory and/or medical tests, such as endoscopy or kidney function tests, may be conducted while you are taking this medication. Ensure you attend all medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
